mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES show that commuting and out-of-home activity are still contracting; this drag will keep RETAIL_REC below its last-28-day mean over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days is greater than or equal to its mean over the last 28 days while TRANSIT and WORKPLACES remain below -60 and -50 respectively.

mechanism_narrative: Once RESIDENTIAL mobility exceeds +20 percent above baseline, home confinement is saturated enough that discretionary retail trips are suppressed; RETAIL_REC will decline further over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL stays at or above +20 percent while RETAIL_REC mean over the next 14 days is higher than over the prior 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: A joint decline in TRANSIT and GROCERY_PHARM means both commuting and essential errands are being curtailed, removing the foot traffic that supports retail-and-recreation venues; RETAIL_REC will fall over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: With TRANSIT below -60 and GROCERY_PHARM below -10, RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days is greater than or equal to its mean over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: In a lockdown regime where WORKPLACES is below -50 and PARKS is below -30, restrictions continue to block retail-and-recreation reopening; RETAIL_REC will stay depressed over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: WORKPLACES <= -50 and PARKS <= -30, yet RETAIL_REC mean over the next 14 days is higher than over the last 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: The PARKS series improving from -42.1 to -35.7 signals a spring outdoor-activity rebound that proxies for gradual behavioral relaxation; this spillover will lift RETAIL_REC over the next week.
failure_condition: PARKS improves or stays above -36 while RETAIL_REC mean over the next 7 days is lower than over the prior 7 days.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM falling below its baseline marks the end of pantry-loading and a shift to stricter shopping routines; reduced errand frequency will drag RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM remains below 0 while RETAIL_REC mean over the next 14 days is higher than over the last 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: A widening gap between rising RESIDENTIAL and falling WORKPLACES indicates work-from-home substitution, which removes commuter-linked retail trips; RETAIL_REC will fall over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: WORKPLACES below -50 and RESIDENTIAL above +20, yet RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days is greater than or equal to its mean over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT falls below -60 percent from baseline, transit-adjacent retail catchments lose a critical share of footfall; RETAIL_REC will decline over the next week.
failure_condition: TRANSIT stays at or below -60 while RETAIL_REC mean over the next 7 days is higher than over the prior 7 days.
